payload.title: corrected-shards paused on the usage limit
payload.body: Paused 2026-09-29 when the account hit its rate limit (retry-after about 131 hours). Loop state by unit, for resuming: wave 0 all six whole (integrated). Wave 1: mav-position achieved at f3d3c50c and kino-position achieved at 8467ee37, both routed to the integrator but not yet integrated (its turn failed on the limit); badge-always-visible landed at 91a71f81 and planner-position landed at 5d2fceb4, both awaiting assay (the badge assay failed on the limit); guard-says-when-open's implementer failed on the limit before returning, so it is redispatched; design-stability and nico-position were still building. Wave 2 not started. Resume: redispatch or re-route each unit from its state above; nothing needs rework from the pause itself.
